description: How a push to /api/expected-points is signed (ADR 0006). The home machine sends the JSON body with two headers: X-FFP-Timestamp, Unix seconds when it was signed, and X-FFP-Signature, 'sha256=' + lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 under LEADERBOARD_PUSH_SECRET (its UTF-8 bytes, used as given: 64 hex characters, not decoded) of the UTF-8 bytes of timestamp + '.' + body. The Function compares in constant time and rejects a timestamp more than 300 s from its clock either way. This vector is checked by both the Python signer and the Function.
